steps.name: Elixir of the Heart (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Elliot] in 「Dorothy Village」, then turn in the quest to [Romalius] in 「Invernel Safe Zone」.

lines.text: (While looking around the village, you notice a boy gazing endlessly at the lakeshore.)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Hmm... What should I do...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Oh... J-Just looking at the lake and wondering what to do...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Well... Well... I'm not sure I should tell you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: There's some homework I have to do on Miss Glinda's orders... I mean, at her suggestion... If I don't, she'll s-scold me...
(Elliot's face turns pale.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Would you like me to help?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: R-Really? Thank you... What a relief...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Miss Glinda is a witch, you know... Recently, she looked at how I was doing and said she'd make an elixir for my heart...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: She said it could make my heart... stronger...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An elixir for your heart?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I've been timid, tearful, and weak since I was little. I wanted to change my personality...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I tried so hard... But it didn't work... Eventually, I turned to something ridiculous: finding a witch and making a wish...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I heard a witch had appeared near Glaston, so I went looking and actually met a real witch, Miss Glinda.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: ...Oh, I'm talking too much... If you speak to me when you have time later, I'll tell you the rest...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Elliot seems better at talking than I am...)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I've found most of the ingredients, but there are a few I couldn't get...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Where would I even find things like these...?
(Elliot hangs his head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry so much. Let me see the ingredients first.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: H-Here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An ominous horn from a high-ranking demon, and a purified horn? No wonder you couldn't find them, Elliot.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But can these really be used in medicine?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I don't know... Only Miss Glinda, the witch, knows...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You got all these? Hair from a cat beastfolk, a rotten tree root, frog eggs, a spirit's tears, a Nab beast's eye...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes... I found most of them along the road and in the village. Oh... I had to go get the beast's eye myself...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: When the Nab beast sleeps, it takes out its eye and sticks it somewhere nearby... I waited for that moment, grabbed it, and ran.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That sounds like it would take quite a lot of courage.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I-I was willing to do even that... If it meant fixing my timid personality...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Elliot really means it...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll look into the demon horns. I happen to know a demon.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: What? Wh-What?! Y-You know a demon?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, he left the Demon Realm and changed sides. You could say he's a good person vouched for by the demigod Lydia.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I-If a demigod vouches for him... H-He must be all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He is. I'll go ask him.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Th-Thank you... Sniff...
(Elliot wipes the tears from his eyes and gives a small smile.)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Um... %s. Wh-Where are you going?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Invernel.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Please try this... Miss Glinda gave it to me... If you eat it, a wind spirit will help carry you on the wind to somewhere near the place you're thinking of...
(Elliot hands %s a small candy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A candy?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: ...I've tried one before... It was fine. It didn't upset my stomach or anything. And...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll trust you and try it, Elliot.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Oh, w-wait...
Gulp.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it? Huh? Huh? Whoaaaa?!
(The moment the candy slips down the adventurer's throat, a gust rises from the lake and rushes toward you.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaah!
(Without giving Elliot time to speak, the wind lifts the adventurer and sends you flying away.)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: ...I was going to say the wind is stronger than you'd expect...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Huh... What was that?
(Sensing someone nearby, Elliot turns around.)
Oh, can you see me? Hehe.
(A girl with long black hair scratches her head and purple horns.)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Was it my imagination...? I thought something was there...
What a relief. You can't see this big sister after all! If you could, I would have taught you a lesson.
Waiting is boring. Should I follow? Oh, I should report in first. What a pain... Ugh...
(The girl presses two fingers to her head and closes her eyes.)
「Tip, it's Tipeta. It looks like getting the horns will be easier than expected. I'm stepping out of Dorothy Village for a while.」
(When the girl calling herself Tipeta lowers her hand, the small wings on her back spread wide.)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Where was Invernel again? Oh, the old Highland.
(Muttering to herself, Tipeta rises into the sky and disappears among the clouds.)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: ...Oh... Oh... M-Miss Glinda was r-right...

steps.name: Elixir of the Heart (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Romalius] in 「Invernel Safe Zone」, then turn in the quest to [Little Bluebird] in 「Vayuna Canyon」.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Are you awake?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I don't recognize your face. Why were you caught on the temple's bell tower? It took some effort to get you down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius, it's me, %s. You know me, right?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh...
(Romalius rubs his eyes and looks at %s's face again.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: So it was you. How did you fly up there without wings?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a long story.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I see. Well, finish your business and head back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you busy right now? I came to ask you something, Romalius.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I've just finished one part-time job and have a little time before the next. What is it? More work?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm making something and need ingredients.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Ingredients? Then I suppose you need a demon's horn.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You guessed...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Perhaps because the horns of demons and demonic beasts contain powerful magic, they're surprisingly useful.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: They're made into magical tools, ground into medicine, or used as decorations.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It sounds like nothing goes to waste...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It would be wonderful if they were used for good, but that often isn't the case...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: So do you need a purified horn or an unpurified one? I need to know its purpose before I can say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Both. As for what they're for...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly explain to Romalius why you need the horns.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh... So I can do a good deed? Ingredients for a medicine to help a boy who lacks courage. How lucky.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suppose so. Huh, Romalius, where are you going?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Wait a moment.
(Romalius hurries into the temple and returns carrying something black.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Here you are.
(Romalius places a broken horn fragment in %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought Lydia took your broken horn...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: A little while ago, the Order said they no longer needed it and would return it.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I wondered what to do with the useless thing and buried it without thinking. When I checked the next morning, it had grown.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: To borrow the words of Daniel, the parrot reporter: 'Under special circumstances, demon horns can grow like this, squawk!'

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: So I've been cutting it into pieces and selling them as souvenirs. Fragments of a high-ranking demon's horn, certified by the Order and purified by a demigod.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: They have no magic left, but they're still useful for various things, so they're popular.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: At this rate, perhaps I'll be able to buy a proper house someday.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're saving for a house. Are you sure you can just give this away?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It's fine. Helping you means helping the goddess. If I tell the Order, they'll raise my hourly pay. It's great.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: If you lose it, come back to me. I'll give you another one. That settles it, right? Oh, you also need an unpurified horn...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: You've met my brother, haven't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Andrea...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I don't really want to mention him, and you probably don't want to see him again, but... Hmm. It can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Go there, use my name, and ask for a horn in repayment of his debt.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will he really give me one?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Trust an honest demon for once. I'd like to go myself, but Andrea would kill me the moment I arrived...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened between you?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Just the sort of fight brothers have.
(Romalius chuckles and pats %s on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I'll be off, then. It's time for my next job.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Romalius.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: If you're really grateful, introduce me to a well-paid part-time job sometime.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's head to Vayuna Gorge. I'll see Sylphid before entering Lysithea's Gate...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh, %s. There was something I didn't get to say... Gone already.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It won't earn me anything, but shall I do a good deed?

steps.name: Elixir of the Heart (3)
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Little Bluebird] in 「Vayuna Canyon」, then enter 「Gate of Lysithea」, defeat [Andrea], and obtain an <Ominous High-Ranking Demon's Horn>.
2. Go out to the reward room and talk to [Andrea], then return to 「Dorothy Village」 and turn in the quest to [Elliot].

lines.speaker: 작은 파랑새
lines.text: Chirp. Chirrrp.
(As the little bluebird flaps its wings, the dust gathered around it vanishes without a trace.)

lines.speaker: 작은 파랑새
lines.text: There. That should do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylphid, here you are.
(The little bluebird called Sylphid startles and retreats.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrrp. Someone I didn't recognize was staring at me, so I disguised myself as a bird... I never thought it was you.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. How did you do that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly explain that since parting with Sylphid, you have been staying in Dorothy Village.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrrp. Remarkable. A witch's medicine has that effect too? And the witch's connection with Lady Iris is surprising as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought so too. Is the gorge all right now?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. No major problems. The Sylphin helped a great deal, so even when gates to the Demon Realm appeared, we destroyed them quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief. But I haven't heard Iris's voice since then.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. She is probably searching for a way. I'm a little concerned that her voice hasn't reached me either, but for now, let's trust the goddess and wait.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrrp. You're going through that gate now, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. As I said, there's something needed in Dorothy Village...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. I don't know whether the demon inside will surrender his horn willingly. Never let your guard down.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrrp. If danger arises inside, or you think you need my help, shout 'Chirrrp!'

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. It needn't be right now. You can do it later too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, chirrrp. I'll remember.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrrp. See you later, then. I'm off to teach a scoundrel a lesson.
(Sylphid waves a small wing in farewell and takes flight.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Take care. I'd better go too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, a scoundrel...? Who did he mean?
(The adventurer looks around the space, where there is still nothing to see but countless doors.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never thought I'd come back here. Where can I find Andrea?
(Sensing something, the adventurer hurriedly steps back. An arrow flies from somewhere and embeds itself in the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Andrea, where are you?
(A man with red horns slowly steps out between the small doors at the far end.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: To think you would return here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you're alive.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Yes, alive. I must stay alive to do anything, after all. Did you come all this way to see whether this stubborn life still clings on?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: You must know what entering this place means...
(Andrea draws his bow and aims at the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I let my guard down then, but today my arrow will pierce your heart...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came with a message from Romalius.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: What?
(At Romalius's name, Andrea lowers his bow.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: What did he say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He said you owe him a debt and told me to collect it on his behalf.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Don't tell me he told you to take my broken horn?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. I need a broken horn from a high-ranking demon.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: That wretch. Thinking only of himself to the very end. Telling me to give a human the horn Lux broke...

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Fine. It's a useless horn anyway. I'll give it to you. But first, you'll have to entertain me.
(With those words, Andrea leaps toward a door high above and vanishes through the gap in an instant.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't really expect him to hand it over... It can't be helped. Let's go.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: ...Enough.
(After taking %s's attack, Andrea steps back and puts away his weapon. Then he takes a broken horn from his clothes and throws it to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're really giving it to me?
(The adventurer puts away the red horn and looks at Andrea.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I've confirmed that you're capable of collecting the debt. That's all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So otherwise, I might not have gotten it...

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: It would be a different matter if Romalius had come himself... But it feels good to be free of that debt.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Thanking someone who tried to kill you... How amusing.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: The exit is the door on the left. Watch your step; your foot may slip through when you leave... Wait, you...

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: You've met Lux. I can smell his foul stench on you.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I knew Lux had left the Demon Realm and was plotting something, but I never expected you to meet him. Hahaha.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: How did you meet Lux?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have no reason to tell you that.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Is that the attitude you'll take when I might have useful information?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll hear it first and decide.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Hehe. I'm trapped here anyway, so it makes no difference. Then I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: The Lux on that side isn't the complete Lux. He split off a part of himself in the Demon Realm and sent it into the human world.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: He was completing something called the Lemegeton. He said that once he obtained what he wanted, everything would be over.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Lemegeton? What he wanted?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I don't know what it is. If I knew, would I be here? I would have killed Lux and taken it myself.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Lux has almost everything in the Demon Realm. Isn't it obvious what else he could want? To become a god.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: From your expression, something serious must have happened. Then answer just one thing. Did Lux create something connected to a god?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: And you, the goddess's follower, stopped it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Things are getting interesting.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Now leave. You'll be in the way when I walk Hellfire.
(Andrea gives a faint laugh, opens a nearby door, and goes inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I learned something new about Lux, but it leaves me uneasy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew. I've got everything I need, so let's return to the village.

steps.name: Elixir of the Heart (4)
steps.objective: Talk to [Elliot] in 「Dorothy Village」, then go to [Runo]. When the conversation ends, turn in the quest to [Runo].

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: It's up there in the sky, right?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Act as though nothing's wrong, just as the boss said. I'll handle the rest.
(Runo pats Elliot's shoulder and walks toward the side of the village where the lakeshore rises.)
(Soon, Tipeta slows in flight and lands atop a building.)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Ugh, how annoying. What a pain.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: A demon with cut-off horns threw a rock at me. Then sparrows came chasing after me and blocked my path. Then skeletal dogs tried to bite me...

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: I shouldn't have followed. I should've just waited. My curiosity is the problem. Oh! Elliot. Elliot!
(Spotting Elliot below, Tipeta smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Elliot, your big sister's back. Were you waiting? Hehe, you can't see me anyway. Oh, the hero is coming too.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Elliot, I'm going to take the horns and return to Emeraldia now. So don't cry even if you miss me. Understood?
(Recognizing %s approaching, Elliot peeks out.)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: %s, y-you're back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Elliot. You were outside?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes... I was talking with Runo...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot, the horns you asked for... Your face is pale. Are you ill?

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: %s, stay right there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Runo?
(Runo suddenly appears, leaps up, and swings the sword from his back. Someone who was invisible to %s moments ago appears and parries the attack.)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: How dare you try to cut the hair I've cherished and grown?! Not a chance, you old deer!!
(Runo tries to attack Tipeta again, but she flies higher into the sky as though taunting him.)

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Tch... A cursed dragonfolk, of all things...

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Elliot, you could see me from the beginning, couldn't you?
(When Elliot's eyes meet Tipeta's, he recoils in terror and runs.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you? You don't seem to be from the village... Those horns, wings, and tail...

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Hello, hero. I really wanted to meet you. I've missed you, you know. I've waited so long, and I'm so happy we finally meet.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Hero, I'm Tipeta. Remember my name. All right? Hehe.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: But what a shame. I know you worked hard to get these horns, yet now they're in my hands.
(Grinning, Tipeta holds up a pouch containing the two horn fragments.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-What? Wh-When...?

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Hehe. When a dragonfolk puts her mind to it, she's faster than a spirit of light.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: I'll put these horns to good use. They aren't ingredients to waste on some mere elixir for the heart.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: And you, Mr. Deer. You thought I didn't notice? Take one more step toward me. Go on, if you want to watch Elliot die right here.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Grr...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Ah... Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't just stand here...)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Ah-ah, you too, hero. Stop. You don't think I'm the only one here, do you?

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Would you be happy if the whole village disappeared? I don't want that either. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Stay still until I leave.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Goodbye, then. We probably won't meet again, but if we do, don't forget that you'll die. Understood?
(Looking satisfied, Tipeta beats her wings and flies toward the road, disappearing from sight.)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Hah... Hah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes... I'm all ri...
(Elliot struggles to smile, then collapses.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot? Elliot!!
(Runo hurriedly checks Elliot and lets out a sigh.)

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Thank goodness. He only fainted... He'd been holding up so well without fainting lately, and now this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We need to tell Glinda right away.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: I'll handle that. Follow me. I'll put Elliot to bed, so wait outside for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Please.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...
(Runo checks the surroundings, then looks at the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Don't worry about Elliot. He's taken a sedative and fallen asleep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief. About that girl... You called her a dragonfolk.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: So you don't know about dragonfolk. Have you heard the term Draconian?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I've heard it somewhere.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: They're one of the groups humans call beastfolk. They're called dragonfolk or Draconians.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: They say an evil dragon was among their ancestors. After mingling with humans, all their descendants were born in that form.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: They resemble beastfolk, but are known for their tremendous strength.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: They were once a major power on the continent of Freios, but became corrupted after allying with demons.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: I heard that around the time of the Chaotic Sky, many factions formed an alliance and subdued them...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why did she come to the village?

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: I don't know the details either. Why a people thought extinct have appeared, or why they came to our village...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to get those things back right away.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: %s. Stop.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They took something Elliot needs. I have to recover it.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: It isn't a guest's concern. We'll handle it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: I'll say it again. The people of Dorothy Village will deal with our own affairs. You came at the goddess's request, so rest quietly before you leave.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: That is the last time I ask. Now it is a warning. If the boss has to intervene personally...

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: I hope it never comes to that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It doesn't seem I'll get any answers right now... I'll try talking later. If I can...)
(Runo silently watches the adventurer give up on the conversation and leave, then sighs.)

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: For now, all we can do is follow the boss's wishes...
